class.name: GodotDoctorValidationSuiteReport
class.brief_description: Holds validation results for a single validation suite, including all scene and resource reports produced during its run.

method.name: _init
method.description: Creates a new [GodotDoctorValidationSuiteReport] for [param suite] with the given [param scene_reports] and [param resource_reports].

method.name: get_num_infos
method.description: Returns the total number of [constant ValidationCondition.Severity.INFO]-level messages across all scenes and resources in this suite.

method.name: get_num_warnings
method.description: Returns the total number of [constant ValidationCondition.Severity.WARNING]-level messages across all scenes and resources in this suite.

method.name: get_num_errors
method.description: Returns the total number of [constant ValidationCondition.Severity.ERROR]-level messages across all scenes and resources in this suite.

method.name: get_num_nodes
method.description: Returns the total number of nodes validated across all scenes in this suite.

method.name: get_num_resources
method.description: Returns the total number of resources validated in this suite.

method.name: get_validation_messages
method.description: Returns all validation messages across all scenes and resources in this suite.

method.name: get_suite_resource_path
method.description: Returns the resource path of the validation suite script.

method.name: get_suite
method.description: Returns the validation suite that was run to produce this report.

method.name: get_scene_reports
method.description: Returns all scene reports in this suite.

method.name: get_resource_reports
method.description: Returns all resource reports in this suite.

members.member: The validation suite that was run to produce this report.
The list of scene reports produced during this suite's validation run.
The list of resource reports produced during this suite's validation run.
